title: Your Rent Is Building Your Landlord's $95K Nest Egg
hook: You've sent over $200,000 in rent checks and kept exactly zero of it — your landlord's bank account tells a very different story.
angle: Renters emotionally justify the choice as flexibility, but the concrete math shows a decade of renting transfers $95K+ in equity to the landlord while the renter's housing net worth stays at zero
audience: Long-term renters aged 25-40 who have never run the numbers, people stuck in the 'I'll buy someday' mindset
key_numbers: Average homeowner builds $95,900 in equity over same 10 years
Renter's net housing equity after 10 years: $0
63% of renters say they plan to buy someday — most never do
